description: This file contains integration tests for the CatalogItem endpoints of the eShopOnWeb project, verifying pagination and multiple parallel calls behaviors.

classes.name: CatalogItemListPagedEndpoint
classes.description: A test class containing methods to verify pagination and parallel API call behaviors for catalog items.

methods.name: ReturnsFirst10CatalogItems
methods.description: Tests that a GET request to the catalog items endpoint returns exactly 10 items when pageSize=10.

methods.name: ReturnsCorrectCatalogItemsGivenPageIndex1
methods.description: Verifies the pagination logic by requesting page index 1 and comparing the expected number of items.

methods.name: SuccessFullMutipleParallelCall
methods.description: Verifies that multiple simultaneous requests to various endpoints succeed with HTTP 200 OK status.
